title: Toxic effects and metabolic response mechanisms of amino-modified polystyrene nanoplastics and arsenic on Microcystis aeruginosa
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3609-3622
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01106F, Paper
Xinwei Shi, Qi Wang, Weitao Liu, Ruiying Shi, Yichen Ge, Jinzheng Liu
This study uncovers how co-exposure to PSNPs-NH2 and arsenic intensifies cyanobacterial stress, disrupts metabolism, and promotes toxin release, revealing new risks to aquatic stability and pollutant behavior.
